summary: Frontend-only regression verification completed on the public URL for all seven static routes plus homepage. Asset-path fix is working: style.css, inner.css and inner.js load correctly on inner pages, content is styled (not raw HTML), images/icons/logos render, and homepage remains isolated from inner assets. MOCKED flows remain unchanged: quote/contact/newsletter submissions are demo frontend-only behaviors.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent net::ERR_ABORTED on /cdn-cgi/rum and challenge assets observed in one run; no impact on local CSS/JS/image/logo loading or rendered UI.

action_items: No functional fix required for the reported asset-path regression.
Optional: monitor preview-only /cdn-cgi telemetry aborts separately from product behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Route-depth handling is correct for one-level and nested two-level routes via data-root plus inner.js path localization.
Homepage remains unchanged and does not include inner.css/inner.js, preserving intended separation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated all seven target routes on public URL: /about-us/, /quality/, /global-presence/, /contact-us/, /other-products/, /rice-products/, /rice-products/1121-basmati-rice/. Confirmed style.css+inner.css+inner.js HTTP 200 on each inner route, images complete with naturalWidth>0, visible inline .ui-icon SVGs and shared logos rendered, and no local asset 404/failed responses. Mobile 390px spot-check passed for About, Rice Products, and 1121 detail including mobile menu rendering.
rca of the issue: Original regression cause was route-depth asset path mismatch on static inner pages. Fix strategy now validated: page-level relative links (../ or ../../) plus inner.js data-root localization of injected header/footer assets and main content root-based paths. This prevents raw unstyled HTML across both one-level and nested routes.
